Common Questions

How do you organize a stacked washer/dryer closet with zero shelves?

Use the side wall with a slim 5-inch rolling cart or magnetic dryer caddy, and hang a foldable over-the-door bar on the nearest bedroom or bathroom door for air-drying.

Will magnetic racks fall off during a heavy spin cycle?

Quality racks with full-sheet rubberized magnets stay put easily, as long as you keep total weight under 8–10 pounds and avoid sticking them over curved edges.
